Fiction.Bank:Pl7.Fields.Counterparty:cou: A natural person, including a joint account held only by natural persons.
An entity managed as a retail exposure whose total funding from the bank's group does not exceed FCR 2.5 million.
A commercial entity that is not a financial institution.
A central government, or one of its agencies or ministries.
A bank responsible for its jurisdiction's monetary policy.
A regional or local government, or a public-sector enterprise.
An insurer, fund, broker-dealer or other financial institution that is not a bank.
Any counterparty not covered by the other types; consult the supervision team before using it.
Fiction.Bank:Pl7.Fields.Guarantee:guaran: NDGS: covered in full by the National Deposit Guarantee Scheme of Fictonia.
Foreign scheme: covered in full by another jurisdiction's government scheme; treated as unguaranteed for Rule 14.
Unguaranteed: not covered in full by any government deposit guarantee scheme.
Fiction.Bank:Pl7.Fields.AssetCode:assetC: GV-1-E: Debt issued by the National Treasury of Fictonia; Tier 1.
GV-2-E: Debt issued by a Fictonian government agency with an explicit National Treasury guarantee; Tier 1.
CB-0-E: Securities issued or guaranteed by a central bank, credit quality step 1; Tier 1.
SV-0-E: Debt issued by a foreign sovereign (excluding central banks), credit quality step 1; Tier 1.
SV-2-E: Debt issued by a foreign sovereign (excluding central banks), credit quality step 2; Tier 2.
PS-1-E: Senior debt issued by a Fictonian public-sector enterprise; Tier 2.
CV-1-E: Covered bonds rated AA- or better; Tier 2.
CR-1-E: Investment-grade debt issued by a non-financial corporate; Tier 3.
EQ-1-E: Common equity in the FX-200 index of the Fictonian Exchange; Tier 3.
PS-1: Public-sector enterprise senior debt that fails the Rule 14.6 tests; not eligible.
EQ-1: FX-200 common equity that fails the Rule 14.6 tests; not eligible.
EQ-2: All other listed common equity; not eligible.
MU-1: Debt issued by a municipality; never eligible under Rule 14, whatever its rating.
ZZ-9: All other assets; not eligible.
Fiction.Bank:Pl7.Fields.AssetCode:tier.t: Tier 1: the highest-quality assets, counted at full market value.
Tier 2: counted at 80% of market value, subject to the Tier 2 and 3 limit.
Tier 3: counted at 40% of market value, subject to the Tier 2 and 3 limit and the Tier 3 limit.
Not eligible: excluded from the stock of eligible liquid assets.
Fiction.Bank:Pl7.Tables.LiquidAssets:unr: Record ID: the bank's identifier for the reported asset line.
Asset code: the code from the Schedule B asset code table.
Market value: the IFRS 13 fair value at close of business on the reporting date, in millions of FCR.
Liquidity desk control: whether the asset meets the operational requirements of Rule 14.7 (Yes = true).
Fiction.Bank:Pl7.Tables.RetailDeposits:r: Record ID: the bank's identifier for the reported balance.
Product: the Part R product the balance is reported under (R.1 to R.5).
Counterparty: the type of legal counterparty that placed the balance.
Guarantee: whether the balance is covered in full by a government deposit guarantee scheme.
Balance: the balance on the reporting date, including accrued interest, in millions of FCR.
Fiction.Bank:Pl7.Tables.RetailDeposits:p: R.1 Operating Accounts: current and payment accounts used for day-to-day transactions.
R.2 Relationship Savings Accounts: savings held by a depositor who also has an operating account or loan with the bank.
R.3 Rate-Seeking Savings Accounts: other savings, including comparison-site and promotional-rate accounts and dormant operating accounts.
R.4 Intermediated Deposits: placed by a broker, platform or wealth manager on behalf of customers.
R.5 Other Retail Balances: banker's drafts, unclaimed balances, merchant settlement balances.
Fiction.Bank:Lrr.Outflows.RetailDeposits: Not covered by rules 14.21 to 14.25: the counterparty is not Retail or Small Business; covered by wholesale rules out of scope.
Fiction.Bank:Lrr.Calculation:lrrCalculat: Calculation ID: identifies one run of the LRR calculation.
Supervisory category: the bank's PLA supervisory category; sets the scaling factor.
Stock of eligible liquid assets: calculated from the unrestricted assets by the liquid asset rules, in millions of FCR.
Retail outflow amount: stressed retail outflows, calculated by rules 14.21 to 14.25, in millions of FCR.
Other outflow amount: stressed outflows from slices not yet modeled (wholesale, secured and other), reported, in millions of FCR.
Inflow amount: stressed inflows from slices not yet modeled, reported, in millions of FCR.
Concentration add-on: calculated under Rule 14.40 and reported on Schedule F, in millions of FCR.
Fiction.Bank:Lrr.Calculation:supervisory: Mid-sized institution with FCR 40 billion or more in short-term wholesale funding: 90 percent.
Mid-sized institution with less than FCR 40 billion in short-term wholesale funding: 80 percent.
